primer: AvePoint, Inc. (NASDAQ: AVPT) is a cloud-native enterprise data resilience and governance platform serving over 25,000 customers across Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, and Salesforce [1][7]. SaaS drives 80.5% of Q3 2026 revenue, with $495.1M ARR (+27% YoY), 112% NRR, 16.8% ROIC, and $418.3M cash with zero funded debt [3][22]. AVPT earns a COMPOUNDER_PASS, and we retain the 153.2332-share Schwab holding ($2,536.01, 2.86% weight) with a $12.47 hard stop. For new capital at $16.55 in a US Correction, we assign ACCUMULATE_ON_DIP at $14.80-$15.60 with a $21.00 base target (1.73:1 asymmetry).
